name: Dr Helen Krstev
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Practising since 2004, I am a clinical psychologist experienced in working with trauma, anxiety & depression, gender & sexuality issues, substance use, relationships, post-traumatic stress, complex difficulties and eating disorders. I work with adults, adolescents and couples, and throughout my career have worked in private practice, public mental health and clinical psychology training.
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, Diverse sexualities, Sexual difficulties

name: Dr Jamie Lopes
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I’m a registered psychologist and clinical psychology registrar with 13+ years – experience working with individuals and couples. I’m also a postdoctoral researcher at Swinburne University, focusing on schizophrenia, neurobiology, attachment, and emotional neuroscience. I’ve worked across public health, community, and private practice with chronic mental illness, trauma, personality disorders, identity, sexuality, and LGBTQIA+ mental health.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Dissociative Identity Disorder, Gender Dysphoria, Sexual difficulties, Diverse genders

name: Olivia Trencher
title: Non-directive Pregnancy Support Psychologist
description: My name is Liv (she/her) and I am a Clinical Psychologist practicing in Fitzroy, VIC. I believe that feeling comfortable with your psychologist is an essential component of therapy. I work holistically with my clients and incorporate a trauma-informed, neuro-affriming and inclusive lense to my practice, and my therapeutic approach draws upon evidence-based modalities including Schema Therapy, CBT, ACT, EMDR and self-compassion.
specialties: Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Gemma Laming
title: Medicare Clinical Psychologist Provider
description: Gemma has experience working with people aged from 16 years through to older adulthood and has immediate availability on Tuesdays and Fridays. Gemma brings a non-judgemental, empathetic approach to sessions. Gemma welcomes all but also has a special interest in providing support for the LGBTIQA+ community
specialties: Gender Dysphoria, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Diverse genders, Diverse sexualities, Sexual abuse, Schema Therapy

name: Dr Jesse Smith
title: Medicare Psychologist Provider
description: Hello, I am a Clinical Psychologist and AHPRA endorsed supervisor. I work with: trauma, mood, stress, anxiety, phobias, substance, relationships, personality disorders, behavioural (i.e., anger). I am proficient across several treatment approaches including Schema Therapy (Advanced Accreditation), EMDR, CBT, DBT, somatic focussed techniques. My passion is utilising emotion focussed techniques that work with attachment experiences, providing deeper level processing and change (i.e., Schema Therapy). LGBTQIA+ member (and ally), sex worker ally, disability ally, neurodiversity affirming.
specialties: Diverse sexualities, Adult survivors of sexual abuse, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), Diverse genders, Sexual abuse, EMDR, Schema Therapy

name: Josh Nguyen
title: Contact Psychologist
description: I am a clinical psychologist and board-approved supervisor in Parkville, Melbourne. I work primarily with couples, LGBTQIA+ adults, neurodivergent adults, and people from multicultural backgrounds. Beyond my clinical practice, I contribute to LGBTQ+ and multicultural mental health at multiple levels, as a member of the advisory group for LGBTIQ+ Health Australia, the Victorian Government's Multicultural Health Advisory Group, and the Co-Chair of the early-career group for the International Association for Suicide Prevention.
